# s286 — list marks blocked rows with !

Text rows in `list`, `find` and `deps` mark an item that waits on an unfinished dependency with `!`, as the TUI queue already does, so the readiness order explains itself.

**Findings:** owner session 2026-10-14: blocked rows in `slicer list` ranked below score-11 rows with nothing showing why · **Size:** S · **Tree:** slicer

**Not in this slice:** a JSON field for blocked state, naming the blockers in the row (`deps ID` does that), and any change to ranking.

## Why

`list` ranks blocked items after every ready item (`graph.ranked_order`, called from `_list_in_priority_order` in `src/slicer/cli.py:1652`). The text row from `_item_rows` (`src/slicer/cli.py:1615`) has no blocked marker, though. On 2026-10-14, s274, s275, s283, s284 and s285 (score 22) listed below s272 and s281 (score 11), and nothing in the row said why. The TUI already puts `!` after the row number (`src/slicer/tui.py:255-259`), and `docs/tui.md` describes it. The CLI should match.
